CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Courarr** builds auto-updating lists for **Sonarr** and **Radarr**: seasonal anime from AniList, and regular TV & movies from TMDB, each sent to Sonarr with the right series type (Anime, Standard or Daily).
Filter by season or year range, genres, streaming service, network, people, studios, runtime, age rating and critic scores; let Courarr add the import lists to Sonarr/Radarr for you; drip-feed big lists; skip titles your Maintainerr rules flag; and get notified about new titles.
Setup, networking and troubleshooting: see the [README](https://github.com/jpjoseph12/courarr#readme). Questions and bugs: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/jpjoseph12/courarr/issues).
